title: The birthday candles
phrase: grandma blows out the candles, zoom in slowly, make it warm and emotional

commands.plan: python3 scripts/shotspeak.py plan --phrase "grandma blows out the candles, zoom in slowly, make it warm and emotional" --subject "an old woman" --action "blowing out the candles on a birthday cake" --setting "a small dark kitchen" --out examples/birthday-candles

bad.prompt: beautiful emotional cinematic shot of grandma blowing out birthday candles, warm glow, soft golden glow, creamy bokeh, smiling at the camera, masterpiece
bad.what_you_get: A smooth, perfect face that smiles into the lens. Everything glows. The candles light nothing.
tells: Fake creamy bokeh, or everything in focus

plain.prompt: An old woman sits at a kitchen table in a small dark kitchen. A birthday cake with lit candles is in front of her. She breathes in and blows out the candles.
plain.what_you_get: The correct moment from the front, at table height. The room is evenly lit, so the candles are not the light. It is flat.

skill.plain_words: The whole camera moves toward the subject. The background slides and grows too.
skill.feel: The viewer leans in. A decision or a realisation is happening.
skill.what_you_get: The camera moves toward her from the side. The candles are the only light. When they go out, the frame goes dark.

decisions.Camera movement: a steady push-in: the camera itself travels toward the subject for the whole shot, from a medium view to a chest-up view
decisions.Camera placement: at the subject's eye height, from the side at a three-quarter angle, starting 3 m away

skill.prompt_block:
SHOT: Push-in (dolly in). 16:9 frame, 3 to 5 s.
SUBJECT AND ACTION: an old woman blowing out the candles on a birthday cake, in a small dark kitchen.
CAMERA MOVE: a steady push-in: the camera itself travels toward the subject for the whole shot, from a medium view to a chest-up view.
CAMERA PLACEMENT: at the subject's eye height, from the side at a three-quarter angle, starting 3 m away.
LENS: 50 mm.
LIGHT: one low warm source, a fire or a single lamp, lighting faces from the side; the light falls off fast into darkness.
COLOUR: photochemical film look: fine grain, deep true blacks with detail, natural skin and material colours, restrained saturation.
SPEED: real time for the whole shot, fast and crisp, no slow motion.
RULES: State the exact number of people. Screen direction stays the same for the whole shot.
AVOID: not a centred front-facing subject; the subject is off-centre, seen in profile, three-quarter or from behind; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean.
skill.one_line: An old woman blowing out the candles on a birthday cake; the camera itself travels steadily toward them from a three-quarter side position at eye height, from a medium view to chest-up, the background sliding past; 50 mm lens; one low warm source, a fire or a single lamp, lighting faces from the side; the light falls off fast into darkness; photochemical film look: fine grain, deep true blacks with detail, natural skin and material colours, restrained saturation; real time for the whole shot, fast and crisp, no slow motion. Avoid: not a centred front-facing subject; the subject is off-centre, seen in profile, three-quarter or from behind; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; real time, with slow motion only where the shot states it.
skill.image_prompt:
A single still frame from a live-action film, 16:9 frame. A storyboard-grade production mock that shows framing, lens, light and colour.
SUBJECT: an old woman blowing out the candles on a birthday cake, in a small dark kitchen. Generic stand-in figures, not a likeness of any real person.
CAMERA: a chest-up frame from a three-quarter side position at the subject's eye height, with a soft foreground edge on one side of the frame that shows the camera is moving in. Camera placement: at the subject's eye height, from the side at a three-quarter angle, starting 3 m away.
LENS: 50 mm; normal lens look: neutral perspective, close to how the eye sees.
LIGHT: one low warm source, a fire or a single lamp, lighting faces from the side; the light falls off fast into darkness.
COLOUR: photochemical film look: fine grain, deep true blacks with detail, natural skin and material colours, restrained saturation.
MOMENT: a sharp frame with a little natural motion blur on the fastest limb only.
FACES: turned away from the lens, in profile, three-quarter or from behind.
AVOID: not a centred front-facing subject; the subject is off-centre, seen in profile, three-quarter or from behind; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; matte worn floor, no glossy or wet reflections; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean; no over-saturated HDR look; restrained colour and true blacks.
One frame only: no collage, no split screen, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no border.
